connector.name: APIThreshold
connector.registryDescription: Quality scoring and progressive gates for AI-generated API tests. Stripe/Twilio profiles. Free tier.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image apithreshold:0.1.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.apithreshold, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
